# `get_sensor_calibration`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Read the balance-sensor and compass-sensor calibration values.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (the handler itself only reads state; the grade reflects the shared diagnostic log writes made by every full call) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, get_sensor_calibration @0xb64a0 |

Returns the device's sensor calibration globals directly, including values for a sensor whose exist flag is false. Physical units and scales are not established by the handler.

Side effects: None beyond the shared diagnostic log writes. Reads calibration globals only.

| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"get_sensor_calibration"`. [READ] |
| `params` | any | no | - | Not read. Omission, null, object, scalar and array all take the same path. Clients SHOULD omit it. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

No handler-specific error is reachable. The compass worker's CompassCalibration events belong to other methods.

## Example

Request, query:

```json
{"id":61,"method":"get_sensor_calibration"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"get_sensor_calibration","result":{"balanceSensor":{"x":0.5,"y":0.25,"z":9.5,"exist":true},"compassSensor":{"x":1.5,"y":-2.5,"z":3.5,"x11":1.0,"x12":0.0,"y11":0.0,"y12":1.0,"exist":false}},"code":0,"id":61}
```
